Based on the two UI crops provided, here is the identification of the purple/violet element:

**What is it exactly?**
It is a **placeholder image** (or default avatar/thumbnail). It represents a missing or generic image for a user or item. It consists of a light purple/lavender background with a darker, solid violet circle in the center.

**What text is near it?**
The text immediately to the left of this element is **"احمد شعبان"** (Ahmed Shaaban), which appears to be a name or title.

*   In the first crop, the text "احمد شعبان" is positioned directly to the left of the circular placeholder.
*   In the second crop, the same name "احمد شعبان" appears above and to the left of the square version of the same placeholder graphic.
